content:
Nina: heads up, deploybot failed the promote for release/v2.14 due to multiple staging canaries failing. change window at 23:00 UTC. tagging @arjun @priya for quick call.

deploybot: Promotion attempt at 1717009999 aborted. Reason: canary failures (ci/staging/canary#7..9). Error snippets: 
- worker-2: GET /v2/app/web/blobs/sha256:ff12 -> 404 Not Found
- worker-3: layer mismatch: expected sha256:ff12 got sha256:xx99
Full logs: https://ci.internal/logs/ci-772 (access restricted).

Arjun: I just saw the registry metrics spike around 1717009800. There was a background GC job that finished ~10m ago; it's possible multipart finalize and GC interleaved causing missing layer tombstones. We also had S3 read 5xxs for ~2m.

Priya: canaries failing on missing blobs is risky. Two options: 1) pin to previous release v2.13 (fast), or 2) delay the change window by 45m to debug and re-publish artifacts (slower). What's the business call?

Nina: product is OK with a short delay if it prevents a rollback. They prefer to avoid pinning unless required. We should estimate fix time.

Arjun: ops plan: 1) pause registry GC; 2) rehydrate missing blobs from mirror (mirror job exists but is async); 3) re-run canaries. If mirror has the blobs we can be ready in ~20-30m. If blobs are lost we must rebuild and republish which is >2h.

QA-bot: Canary results overview:
- canary#7: failed 00:02:12 - missing blob ff12
- canary#8: failed 00:01:45 - layer digest mismatch
- canary#9: failed 00:00:58 - network 502 to registry
(automated rerun suggested but blocked by change window start)

Priya: given mirror likely has copies, I vote to delay the window 30-45m. Set a hard cutoff: if not green by +45m, pin to v2.13 and open incident ticket. We need to notify stakeholders.

Nina: agree. I'll message product and support and update the change calendar. Priya, @deploybot can you hold the promote and set a manual unblock deadline of 1717010280 (45m)?

deploybot: Promotion queued on hold until 1717010280 per request 'hold-due-to-registry-gc-eviction'. Will auto-abort at cutoff.

Arjun: paused GC, kicked mirror rehydrate job, triggering: `infra/registry-mirror rehydrate --prefix app/web --since 1717009600`. Watching S3 copy logs now.

QA-bot: re-running canaries once mirror reports success. Suggested: run 2 fast canaries first (parallel) then full suite if green.

Arjun: mirror reported 86% rehydrated at 1717010100, finalizing at 1717010200. Starting canary reruns.

deploybot: Canary reruns started: ci/staging/canary#10..11.

QA-bot: canary#10 passed; canary#11 passed. Secondary regressions: smoke and acceptance started.

Priya: great. If acceptance passes, we proceed with promote. Keep the release note short: "delayed window; resolved missing layers from registry GC during publish; promoted after mirror rehydrate; follow-up INFR-4030." Nina please add.

Nina: acceptance passed. Proceeding with promote to v2.14. Command executed: `deploybot promote --release release/v2.14 --strategy rolling --reason "rehydrated-missing-blobs"`

deploybot: Promotion succeeded. prod now at v2.14. Promotion timestamp: 1717010255.

Nina: filing INFR-4030: investigation summary, timeline, and mitigations (pause GC overlap with publish, add pre-promote blob HEAD checks, increase mirror sync priority). Assigning to Arjun for remediation.

Arjun: will follow up with a patch to registry GC to check for in-progress publishes and add a pre-promote manifest digest verification in deploybot. PR target EOD.

Priya: thanks everyone. Notifying product/support and updating release notes. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
